serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
So this is the police station, huh…
It’s a nice looking building, outside and inside.
I didn’t suspect that there would be so many people though. Are they all here to report a crime?
This could take a while…
Whatever! I’m not going to change my mind only because of this!
Lucky me! One slot just opened up at the reception desk.
Let’s ask the lady there where I should go exactly.
You: Um, excuse me.
Receptionist: …
You: Hi…
Receptionist: …
Is she even listening to me? She’s typing something on her desktop. Is that the right moment to bother her? Maybe I should wait?
You: …
Receptionist: What, are you going to just stand there? What do you want.
You: O-oh, right. I’m sorry. I just thought that…{{wi}} Never mind…
You: I would like to report a crime.
Receptionist: Is said crime in progress?
You: No…
Receptionist: Is that crime a violent one?
You: Yes, I think so, yeah.
Receptionist: …
Ugh, she gave me a long stare…
Receptionist: Fill this form and wait in line for room 16. It’s on this floor.
That’s a lot of paperwork… It’s somewhere around 20 pages.
You: Sorry, but I forgot to bring a pen. Could I borrow one?
Receptionist: I’m not obligated to. Now please move away so I can help the next person in the line.
You: S-sorry, but I didn’t know that I would need a pen…
Receptionist: Alright! Just take this pen and move away already!
You: Thanks…
She didn’t have to scream at me…
This job must be more stressful than I thought.
Anyway. I need to find some place to sit down and fill all of this up.
